title: fastapi-templates
summary: Guides creation of structured FastAPI backend projects using async patterns, dependency injection, repository and service layers, authentication, and testing examples. Includes templates for API endpoints, database access, and user management.

title: systematic-debug
summary: Use test bombs to narrow an unclear bug to a likely component, and layered tests to isolate the failing stage in a pipeline. Keep the resulting tests as regression coverage and use the identified failure to guide the fix.

title: connect-apps
summary: Connect Claude to external apps through Composio Tool Router so it can perform actions such as sending emails, posting messages, and creating issues. The skill also describes setup and authorization for the integration.

title: vibe-security
summary: Apply secure-by-default practices when building or reviewing web applications, protecting access, user data, inputs, outputs, and common application attack surfaces. Choose restrictive security options while preserving functionality.

title: debugging-strategies
summary: Use systematic steps to investigate bugs and performance problems, from reproducing behavior and gathering evidence to testing hypotheses and verifying fixes. Apply debugging and profiling techniques across codebases and technology stacks.

title: fastapi-endpoint
summary: Guides the agent through exploring an existing FastAPI project, asking clarifying questions, planning an endpoint implementation for approval, and then building the endpoint and tests. It emphasizes async SQLAlchemy, Pydantic schemas, dependency-injected authentication, and API test coverage.

title: instantly-automation
summary: Use the Composio MCP integration to manage Instantly cold-email campaigns, sending accounts, lead lists, and campaign analytics from natural-language requests. Apply the documented constraints when configuring schedules, sequences, imports, and campaign updates.

title: connect
summary: Connect Claude to external apps through Composio so it can execute actions such as sending messages, creating issues, and updating records instead of merely describing them. Supports several agent frameworks and MCP clients.

title: bolt
summary: Bolt directs the agent to identify measurable performance improvements, follow a profiling-to-presentation workflow, and document their impact. It also sets limits on implementation, optimization scope, and when to ask for confirmation or hand off work.

title: openapi-spec-generation
summary: Guides agents in creating and maintaining OpenAPI 3.1 specifications from design or code, validating API contracts, and generating SDKs and documentation. Includes patterns for reusable schemas, API descriptions, security, versioning, and validation tools.

title: tdd
summary: Follow a red-green-refactor workflow by writing focused behavior tests and implementing only enough code to pass each test. Plan around public interfaces and user-prioritized behavior, then refactor after tests pass.

title: scout
summary: Investigate one bug at a time by reproducing failures, tracing evidence to a root cause, assessing impact, and producing a structured handoff. Do not implement fixes; provide fix direction and regression-test ideas to the appropriate agents.

title: architecture-patterns
summary: Guides the agent in designing or refactoring backend systems with Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design. It emphasizes inward dependencies, framework-independent business logic, and testability without external infrastructure.

title: debug-root-cause
summary: Use a systematic debugging process to reproduce and isolate a bug, test root-cause hypotheses, and make a minimal fix. Verify the original failure is resolved and add prevention measures where appropriate.

title: radar
summary: Add and refine tests, diagnose flaky behavior, and improve coverage while preserving product behavior. Follow the project’s existing testing conventions and verify changes with tests and relevant references.

title: coding-guidelines
summary: Use cautious, scope-limited coding practices: clarify uncertainty, favor simple solutions, and make only changes directly tied to the request. Define verifiable goals and verify code changes before considering the task complete.

title: backend-patterns
summary: Provides TypeScript-oriented backend patterns for API design, data access, query optimization, caching, error handling, authentication, rate limiting, background jobs, and logging. Recommends choosing patterns suited to the complexity level.

title: sentinel
summary: The skill directs the agent to identify and remediate one security issue or add one security enhancement per invocation, following a severity-focused scan, fix, and verification workflow. It also specifies reporting, routing, logging, and special handling for multi-engine and Nexus workflows.

title: variant-analysis
summary: Guides systematic searching for variants of a known vulnerability or bug, from understanding its root cause through generalizing patterns and triaging matches. Emphasizes broad codebase coverage, incremental query refinement, and checking edge cases and false positives.

title: pptx
summary: For PowerPoint tasks, choose the appropriate creation, editing, or reading workflow and follow the skill’s implementation and design guidance. Validate the deck and inspect its content and rendered slides before considering the work complete.

title: tdd-workflow
summary: Follow a test-driven workflow by writing tests before implementation, running tests through development, and refactoring while keeping them green. Aim for at least 80% coverage across unit, integration, and E2E tests, with attention to edge cases and errors.

title: polyglot
summary: Guides agents through internationalization and localization work, including extracting strings, structuring translation keys, locale-aware formatting, ICU messages, and RTL support. It requires using the project's existing i18n conventions and producing a documented summary of the changes.

title: dynamics365-automation
summary: Use the Dynamics 365 CRM toolkit through Rube MCP to manage CRM records, including leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities, sales orders, invoices, and support cases. Check the toolkit connection before using tools and follow the documented reference and OData formats.

title: docx
summary: Use DOCX-specific workflows and helper scripts to create, read, edit, and annotate Word documents. Follow the listed docx-js and XML handling requirements, then validate or render outputs where directed.

title: semgrep-rule-creator
summary: Guides the agent through creating custom Semgrep rules, from consulting documentation and designing tests to validating and optimizing rules. It emphasizes specific detections, safe-case coverage, and taint mode for data-flow vulnerabilities.

title: google-admin-automation
summary: Automates Google Workspace administration through Rube MCP, including user and group management, memberships, and account changes. Requires checking current tool schemas and ensuring the Google Admin connection is ready before workflows.

title: improve-retention
summary: Use the Fogg Behavior Model (B=MAP) and Tiny Habits to diagnose retention and behavior-design problems. Favor easier, smaller behaviors and well-timed prompts, and assess behavior designs with a score and specific improvements.

title: vercel-react-best-practices
summary: Provides React and Next.js performance guidance for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code. It prioritizes practices for async work, bundle size, server and client performance, rendering, and JavaScript efficiency.

title: landing-page
summary: Generate a complete, deployable landing page as a single HTML file using Tailwind CSS via CDN. Gather a brief, build a responsive and accessible page with suitable sections and interactions, then provide preview and deployment guidance.

title: codenavi
summary: Investigate unfamiliar codebases methodically, implement only what the task requires, and verify uncertain knowledge against current sources. Preserve useful discoveries in a `.notebook/` knowledge base and communicate plans, uncertainty, and verification results clearly.

title: gorgias-automation
summary: Use the Rube MCP integration to manage Gorgias tickets, customers, tags, teams, and account activity from natural-language requests. Follow the documented API requirements and pagination, filtering, custom-field, rate-limit, and authentication guidance.

title: forge
summary: Use Forge to build small, runnable prototypes that validate ideas, relying on mocks where useful and keeping work ready for handoff. Prioritize learning and working demos over production polish, and report the prototype’s status, findings, debt, and next decision.

title: test-driven-development
summary: Follow a test-first development cycle: write a failing test, verify the failure, implement the minimum code to pass, then refactor while keeping tests green. Apply this approach to features, bug fixes, and integration debugging.

title: n8n-expression-syntax
summary: Guides the agent to write and troubleshoot n8n expressions, including variable access, webhook data paths, and syntax rules. It also distinguishes expression syntax from direct JavaScript access in Code nodes and identifies places where expressions should not be used.

title: ln-020-codegraph
summary: Use the code knowledge graph to index and query a project for symbols, dependencies, call flows, implementations, and architecture. Present query results directly and suggest relevant follow-up queries.

title: negative-contrastive-framing
summary: Use negative examples, near-misses, and failure patterns to clarify concepts and turn fuzzy boundaries into actionable criteria. Create and validate a framework that pairs a positive definition with contrasts and operational decision rules.

title: qa
summary: Conduct conversational QA by lightly clarifying reported problems, exploring the codebase for user-facing context, and filing durable GitHub issues. Break reports into independently actionable issues when appropriate, then share the issue URLs and continue the session.

title: shortcut-automation
summary: Enables natural-language automation of Shortcut workflows, including creating and listing stories, managing tasks and comments, and discovering workflow or project IDs. It guides story creation toward workflow states and documents required fields and batch limits.

title: relay
summary: Designs and implements messaging integrations, including channel adapters, webhooks, bots, event routing, and real-time transports. Requires reliable delivery, security controls, platform-aware message handling, and Japanese final outputs.

title: quickbooks-automation
summary: Guides the agent through QuickBooks Online workflows for managing customers, accounts, and invoices using the QuickBooks toolkit. Requires checking the toolkit connection and resolving relevant records before invoice creation.

title: quickdup
summary: Use QuickDup to find code-duplication candidates, inspect and classify them, then refactor with an approach suited to the duplication type. Re-run the scan to verify the results.

title: builder
summary: Guides the agent to implement production-ready, type-safe business logic, API integrations, and data models, with validation, error handling, and test handoffs. It emphasizes TypeScript strictness, domain-appropriate patterns, and Japanese final outputs.

title: chain-estimation-decision-storytelling
summary: Guide the agent through estimating uncertain outcomes, comparing options with decision analysis, and presenting a stakeholder-ready recommendation. It emphasizes transparent assumptions, sensitivity analysis, and calibrated communication.

title: discernment-nudge
summary: For substantive answers users may act on, add a one-time discernment nudge with specific follow-up questions, unless the request falls into an exclusion. Keep the answer complete and place the plain-text nudge at the end in the specified format.

title: benchmark-email-automation
summary: Automates Benchmark Email tasks through Rube MCP and Composio. The agent discovers current tool schemas, checks the Benchmark Email connection, and executes workflows using the discovered tools.

title: vercel-cli-with-tokens
summary: Guides the agent through token-based Vercel CLI setup, deployment, and project management without interactive login. It prioritizes preview deployments, protects tokens, and requires approval before git pushes.

title: yeet
summary: For an explicitly requested stage, commit, push, and GitHub pull request flow, use `gh` and follow the prescribed branch, commit, checks, push, and PR steps. The skill also specifies PR description content and handling.

title: obsidian-vault
summary: Guides searching and organizing an Obsidian vault, and creating notes and index notes that follow its naming and linking conventions. It also specifies how to find backlinks and handle notes in numbered sequences.

title: clockify-automation
summary: Enables Clockify time-tracking workflows through the Rube MCP integration, including managing time entries and timers, querying historical data, and finding workspace and user information. It also guides ID resolution, timestamp formatting, pagination, and workspace-scoped tag use.

title: market-research
summary: Conduct decision-oriented market, competitor, investor, and technology research with clear source attribution. Evaluate evidence, risks, and recommendations so findings support business decisions.
